I’m checking the exact version-specific API and CSS hooks before editing.

item.text:
Implemented view transitions across the gallery:

- Product thumbnails morph into their matching detail hero using shared transition names.
- Grid → detail slides forward; “Back to products” slides in reverse.
- Suspense skeletons fade/slide smoothly into loaded content.
- `prefers-reduced-motion` disables view-transition animations and skeleton pulsing.
- Transition overlays don’t block pointer interaction.

Key changes: [ProductGrid.tsx](/workspace/app/ProductGrid.tsx:9), [product page](/workspace/app/product/[slug]/page.tsx:45), [home page](/workspace/app/page.tsx:11), and [globals.css](/workspace/app/globals.css:129).

Verification: `npm run build` passes, including TypeScript and static-page generation.
